description: Amendments of v4's state machines that the owner approved (ODR-V41-08, APR-V41-OWNER-2). v4 is frozen at tag indy-init-requirements-v4.0.0 and its files are never edited: requirements-compiler v41 applies each transition over the frozen machines when it compiles state-machine-contracts.json, and check X12 requires each to name its owner decision and operator approval and to fit its machine (known states and events, deterministic guards). No state or event is added.

effects: record the sent request as the session's outstanding request (its RequestId); an answer to any other request is SupersededReply

accepted.note: SM-LOAD keeps no transport-failure event: a provider refusal, a transport failure or a lost answer during a load is LoadRejected carrying LoadFailure.ProviderFailed (IF41-SAVE), as the owner accepted. No transition is added.
